market_pulse.note: Fell below $63,000 by about 10:48 a.m. ET Wednesday, down more than 2.5%, after trading near $65,000 early in the day; it hit a four-month low of $61,000 on Nov. 15 (CoinDesk).
About $1,790, down 1.64% over 24 hours on Nexo's ticker; CoinDesk's ticker showed about $1,782 (Nexo; CoinDesk).
About $2.26 trillion per CoinGecko data cited by Analytics Insight and CoinGabbar; CoinGabbar put it up 0.9% over 24 hours before Bitcoin's late-morning dip (Analytics Insight; CoinGabbar).
About 57.1% to 57.5% per CoinGecko-based figures, with Ether at about 9.7% to 9.8% (CoinGabbar; Analytics Insight).

themes.title: Bitcoin misses the Nvidia lift
themes.summary: Nvidia beat estimates, but Bitcoin did not join the early tech rally and slipped below $63,000 by late morning (CoinDesk).

themes.title: Fed hike bets firm up
themes.summary: Fed Governor Chris Waller again called for a half-point increase in December; CME FedWatch showed a 96% chance of a quarter-point hike to 4.25% (CoinDesk).

themes.title: Short-term holders under water
themes.summary: CryptoQuant said Bitcoin trades about 20% below the cost basis of one-to-three-month holders, the widest gap since July, and sees support between $62,000 and $65,000 (CoinDesk).

themes.title: Spot ETF outflows
themes.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs had $239.9 million of net outflows on Nov. 17, and sentiment gauges stayed in 'extreme fear' (Analytics Insight; Nexo).

themes.title: Crypto treasury stocks slide
themes.summary: Strategy's STRC preferred fell 3% to $95.75, its lowest since August, and MSTR fell 4% to $93.81 by 10:48 a.m. ET (CoinDesk).

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Both lower Wednesday: Bitcoin down more than 2.5% below $63,000 and Ether down about 1.6% near $1,790 (CoinDesk; Nexo).

categories.name: Altcoins
categories.note: Selective gains: XRP rose about 4.6% to near $1 and Solana about 3.4% to near $75, while Zcash rose nearly 4% to about $955 early in the day (Analytics Insight; CoinDesk).

categories.name: Derivatives
categories.note: Crypto perpetual funding rates have settled around 3% to 5% this year, versus about 11% for the largest equity-linked perps, which hold over $11 billion in open interest (CoinDesk).

categories.name: Stablecoins
categories.note: DBS and Circle announced a partnership letting eligible institutional clients mint and redeem USDC through DBS (CoinGabbar).

watch_list.why: Minutes from the Fed's October meeting are due Wednesday afternoon, with a December rate increase priced at about 96% (CoinDesk; Nexo).
CryptoQuant flagged this range as support; Bitcoin's Nov. 15 low was $61,000 (CoinDesk).
Anthropic's IPO is set to price Wednesday and trade Thursday, alongside the Philadelphia Fed index and jobless claims; crypto has been tracking tech sentiment (Nexo).

movers.name: Momentum (MMT)
movers.note: Among the top 24-hour gainers in CoinGecko data, on more than $319 million in volume (CoinGabbar).

movers.name: Pippin (PIPPIN)
movers.note: Another top 24-hour gainer in CoinGecko data (CoinGabbar).

movers.name: XRP (XRP)
movers.note: Up about 4.6% over 24 hours, trading near $1 (Analytics Insight).

movers.name: Solana (SOL)
movers.note: Up about 3.4% over 24 hours, near $75 (Analytics Insight).

movers.name: Bitcoin (BTC)
movers.note: Down more than 2.5% and below $63,000 by about 10:48 a.m. ET (CoinDesk).
